notes.title: Version 1.0a !
notes.notes:
[h1]Here's the version 1.0a of Tennis Elbow 4 ![/h1]

After nearly 9 years of development through TEM2+TE4, I'm finally on the edge of moving on to new projects ! 🥳

It's still not the end of the road for TE4, though, and I'll still improve the game here and there in the coming years, but once this new version is stabilized, I won't work full-time on TE4 anymore.

I'll likely do the official release of the game during the Australian Open 2026, next January.

I hope you'll enjoy it, and here's the full changelog.

[h2]New Features :[/h2]
- Animation : new motion-captured movement animations (if you prefer to use the Legacy ones, disable Settings -> 3D Match -> Motion-captured animations)
- Animation : now the player walks when you move left/right while preparing your service (only available when the Mocap anim are enabled)

[h2]Bug Fixes :[/h2]
- Strike : the normal strike after the bounce (ie: not a volley) could end too long, even when prepared for a very long time, when standing near the net
- Animation : left players could get their animations mirrored
- World Tour : Pure Junior Players (the ones who will never make it Pro) could get an incorrect skin color
- World Tour : some Junior streaks weren't tracked at all
- Online : now if you only have a IPv6 and no IPv4, you should still be able to connect to the online mode

ManuTOO
=== Mana Games ===

notes.title: Version 1.0 !
notes.notes:
Hello,

after nearly 6 years of development, we finally reached the version 1.0 of Tennis Elbow 4 ! ːsteamhappyː

It's still not the end of the road and I'll still improve the game, but once I'm done with the new movement animations (either it's a success or a failure :fear: ), I won't work full time on TE4 anymore.

And here's the full changelog for the version 1.0 - Build 137 ; SubBuild 2025.3.4:

[h2]New Features :[/h2]
- Animation : experimental new movement animations ! I used the animation set bundled with the Motion Matching plug-in I bought, which direly misses sidesteps and small footwork ; you can activate it in Settings -> 3D Match (Give your impressions => https://www.managames.com/Forum/topic7-36310.php ) ; note : this system requires some extra memory and will lead to crash on consoles if you have Mods installed (especially when playing doubles)
- Settings : added a Tennis.ini editor ; click on the little white icon on the bottom right of Settings -> Misc Options to access it
- World Tour : rankings updated to 2024, and new players added if you start a new career (if you have a Mod for the World Tour, you won't see these additions)
- Localization : Japanese translation, thanks to Tam ! (please report any typo)

[h2]Changes :[/h2]
- Strike : halved the loss of power when getting tired, which should shorten rallies by making it easier to hit winners when both players are tired
- Strike : boosted the short strike speed by up to 4km/h, to help doing passing shots with it (it was too curvy and slow before, allowing too many easy volleys)
- Service : raised the Aiming Zone on Service Preview so the ball should almost never land outside of it
- AI : lowered the jump at the net of the CPU for the Club-10 and Junior-10 so their rally & net performances are more balanced (this will have some diminished effect till Pro-9)
- Physics : now, hitting the ball with the frame of the racket will make the normal & long strikes end too long instead of in the net

[h2]Bug Fixes :[/h2]
- Animation : the player could bend too harshly in some situations (usually when sliding)
- Animation : animation loading was randomly failing, leading to a crash (and online desyncs) ; tried a fix, but I'm not 100% sure it'll work in all cases (it's a Unity bug :fear: )
- 3D Match : after having played for a while (ie: more than 30 minutes), the hair, hat, and possibly the eyes were moved over the head
- Physics : some topspin balls had a too low chance to end in the net
- Commentary : fixed a few lines played in the wrong situation
- World Tour & Camera : (consoles only) since the last update, it was not possible to export your player to the Training Club nor save a Camera in Settings -> Camera
- World Tour : the Experience points were capped at 200 when starting a 3D match
- Modding : modifying the RankPerYear in the Player bases wasn't seen right away in your saved career

notes.title: Version 0.99 - Build 135 ; SubBuild 2024.10.16
notes.notes:
Sorry for the longer delay than usual since the last update : I was very taken with the PlayStation port.

But it didn't mean I didn't work on the game either, and this update got its fair part of additions, tuning & bug fixes, as usual..! 🙂

[h2]New Features :[/h2]
- UI : you can now raise the font size in Settings -> Misc ; this is done automatically on the 1st run on SteamDeck (for new users)
- Online : you can now permanently ban a player (and unban him at any time from Online / LAN -> Banned players)
- Preview : added different ball impact previews (set it in Settings -> 3D Match)
- Modding : it's now possible to move the match time & speed texts (read the section "7) Moving the Speed & Match time texts around" here for explanations : topic60-34047.php )

[h2]Changes :[/h2]
- AI : the Incredible CPU will now be much much harder to be aced by another CPU player (against humans, it's still the same)
- Modding : modded animations aren't all loaded anymore on game start-up, to speed up the init and save some memory

[h2]Bug Fixes :[/h2]
- AI : the CPU could let the ball pass after having jumped at the net
- Animation : the CPU could hit the ball with his racket far from it because he didn't reach for it
- Animation : some strike animations could get very strange when done while running or just after finished to run :fear:
- Xbox : the game was very slow to load with big Mods


Cu next month for the 1.0..? 😋

ManuTOO
=== Mana Games ===

notes.title: Version 0.98 - Build 133 ; SubBuild 2024.7.24
notes.notes:
Here's an update bringing a long requested feature : the Service Aiming Preview ! As well as an important fix for Xbox helping to lower Mod memory consumption, in addition to several little fixes & changes, as usual. Enjoy ! 🙂

Here's the complete changelog :

[h2]New Features :[/h2]
- Helpers : added the aiming preview for the service (note : your preview in the World Tour might be changed, you can set it back to your wanted level, go to your Character Sheet)
- Modding : it's not possible to rotate the NPCs and hide the middle line judge (see section 5 here topic60-34047.php )

[h2]Changes :[/h2]
- Service : lowered the maximum possible spin for the very slow services (under ~100km/h), because the curve was way too pronounced
- Online : raised the number of Talent Stars from 4 to 5

[h2]Bug Fixes :[/h2]
- Replay : the ball impact mark could be slightly misplaced on serve
- AI : in some cases, the CPU could think the ball was going into the net while actually it wasn't, leading to having no strike anim and possibly other issues
- Menus : the player photos could get distorted
- World Tour : disabling the Alternate Acceleration Style wasn't saved
- Modding : textures whose dimensions were not power-of-2 were using double the needed memory (note : it's much better to have power-of-2 sized textures so they can get compressed and use 75% less memory !)

ManuTOO
=== Mana Games ===

notes.title: Version 0.97 - Build 131 ; SubBuild 2024.6.26
notes.notes:
Here's an update to rebalance a bit the attack/defense, as well as fixing some bugs, I hope you'll enjoy it..! 🙂

[h2]New Features :[/h2]
- Localization : Chinese translation updated, thanks to XK !

[h2]Changes :[/h2]
- Gameplay : raised the Short Acceleration speed a bit, especially when it's done at shoulder height
- Gameplay : hitting an acceleration against a raising/falling ball now lowers the precision on extreme cases and a bit less the accel speed (and still reduces the speed as before on normal cases)
- Gameplay : accelerations are a tiny bit longer
- Gameplay : All Rounder & All-court Attacker's normal strike speed bonus now applies only to the forehand and not to the backhand anymore

[h2]Bug Fixes :[/h2]
- AI : the CPU could miss the ball by a few centimeters when rushing the net
- Gameplay : the service line was seen as 0cm wide for the fault calls, making some balls fault when they should have been in
- World Tour : some saved games could be wrongly flagged as invalid when switching between men & women in the Load menu
- Commentary : serve context was always on the 1st serve, even during the 2nd serve, giving a series of wrong comments
- Launch : since a recent update, the NoMod option was making the game crashes

=== Mana Games ===

notes.title: Version 0.96 - SubBuild 2024.6.3
notes.notes:
Here's an important quality-of-life update for users with several controllers, as well as an attempt to provide better running animations ; please answer this poll to let me know if you think they are an improvement or not => https://www.managames.com/Forum/topic15-35484.php .


[h2]New Features :[/h2]
- Controls : now the Configuration selection is separated from the Controller selection ; this allows you to easily share the same configuration between several controllers, or reassign the Controller without changing the Configuration in case the Controller index has changed (in case you have more than 1 controller)
- Controls : on PC, when possible, the game automatically reassigns on launch your last selected controller if its index changed (because you have plugged in or out another controller)

[h2]Changes :[/h2]
- Animation : changed the forward & backward running animations
- Animation : changed the base pose of the male player, as his back was a bit bent ; this slightly changes the back orientation on all animations (the male player should hopefully look a bit less stiff)

[h2]Bug Fixes :[/h2]
- Modding : it was still possible for the Mods installation to get stuck more or less forever ; it should now be ok in all cases (as long as you have enough space left on your drive, of course ːsteammockingː )
- Controller : controller auto-selection didn't work when having more than 1 player in the World Tour
- Menu : with the onscreen keyboard, it was not possible to clear a text field (eg: the Rankings filtering)
- Match replay : all replays could desync, and the World Tour ones were always desync'ing when recorded with the match introduction enabled

[h2]Notes :[/h2]
- No gameplay change, I'm waiting for the end of the online Slam tournaments :fear:


ManuTOO
=== Mana Games ===

notes.title: Version 0.95 - Build 130 ; SubBuild 2024.5.22
notes.notes:
Here's another regular update, bringing some gameplay tuning and the usual fixes. I hope you'll enjoy it. :-)

And if you have missed it, the game is finally released on Xbox since a couple of weeks : https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/tennis-elbow-4/9nfwhqkgc6p0 .

Now, I'm going to move to the Playstation port, hoping for a release around October.

[h2]New Features :[/h2]
- Camera : added a slider to make the camera movements slower in 3rd person mode when the ball passes your player (ie: it's mostly for the doubles)
- Modding : added an "Available space" indicator to know if you still have enough space to install additional Mods (especially useful on Xbox, where you have only 1GB for the Mods and the match recordings)

[h2]Changes :[/h2]
- Players : Male hairs were too bright
- Strike : slightly lowered the loss of precision when returning a slice with a 2H-BH or 1H-BH
- Strike : strongly lowered the tiring handicap on heavy topspin strikes, and even more for the Defender style
- Physics : slightly changed the ball size so it gets a tiny bit more air drag, more on par with current balls on the real World Tour (but it's only like 1/60th of a second longer for the ball to travel from one player to his opponent ːsteammockingː )
- Physics : the players with high running speed need now a bit more time to stop their run
- Gameplay : the Bulldog has now a little bonus to more easily hit the ball on the run

[h2]Bug Fixes :[/h2]
- Strike : preparing a strike for a long time was canceling the handicap to do an acceleration on a raising/falling ball, making the topspin balls less effective than wanted
- AI : the CPU could walk a bit away from the ball and miss it when rushing the net
- Tutorial : doing a net on the 1st serve was crashing the game
- Desync : the online matches and match replays could sometimes desync on the service (I'm not sure it's fixed in 100% of the cases, though :fear: )

ManuTOO
=== Mana Games ===

notes.title: Version 0.94 - Build 129 ; SubBuild 2024.4.29
notes.notes:
Here's another regular update with QoL improvements and 2023 rankings for the World Tour, enjoy ! :-)

[h2]New Features :[/h2]
- World Tour : rankings updated to the end of 2023 (but the 1st playable year is still 2023)
- Controls : added Tab Previous & Next, and Scroll Previous & Next as configurable buttons, and added shortcuts for them in different menus
- Optimization : the game now uses noticeably less memory and prevents Mods from using too much of it, so you can enjoy everything with 6 GB of RAM
- Steam : enabled the "Join game" & "Invite to play" buttons in the "view game info" dialog, in the Steam friends list right-click menu (I couldn't test it, so please let me know if there's some issue :fear: )

[h2]Changes :[/h2]
- Strike : very slightly lowered the loss of precision when returning a slice (as the increase in the previous Build was too strong ːsteammockingː )
- AI : the Incredible CPU now aims a bit less to the center

[h2]Bug Fixes :[/h2]
- Animation : the players could do weird movements to try to look for the ball behind them if they had just missed it
- Online : since the last Build, it was not possible to open the Chat with the keyboard or the in-game menu
- Controls : having a strike activated by a controller axis and another strike activated by the same axis plus a button could lead to the latter strike never getting registered

ManuTOO
=== Mana Games ===

notes.title: Version 0.92 - Build 128 ; SubBuild 2024.4.10
notes.notes:
Here's another regular update with important bug fixes as well as the possibility of tuning the Dynamic Animation system.

I hope you'll enjoy it ! :-)

[h2]New Features :[/h2]
- Animation : you can now damper or turn off the Dynamic Animation system, which alters the strike animations (more info => https://www.managames.com/Forum/topic15-35348.php )

[h2]Changes :[/h2]
- Strikes : the slice was too fast when having low consistency
- Strikes : slightly increased the loss of precision when returning a slice
- Strikes : lowered the maximum possible topspin when having a very low power (to avoid weird moonballs for Junior players)
- Strikes : slightly raised the racket sweet spot size while moving, so it's now a bit easier to strike the ball on the run

[h2]Bug Fixes :[/h2]
- World Tour : in fictional years, the ranks were getting all messed up when some real players had manual rankings, leading to unknown players being way too strong
- AI : when doing a safe strike, the CPU could advance too much into the court
- Strikes : the drop shot speed could be too slow when done very crossed, leading to a too-high trajectory
- Online : when doing a rematch, the stadium for the client was reset to his own settings, instead of the host's stadium
- Online : The NAT punch-through when having different private & public ports was not working (it can happen when you share your router with a lot of people ; eg: at university)


ManuTOO
=== Mana Games ===

notes.title: Version 0.91 - Build 127 ; SubBuild 2024.3.9
notes.notes:
Here's a new version with some improvements on the online side, I hope you'll enjoy them !

And if you have SteamDeck, please let me know if the on-screen Keyboard pops up automatically when you want to edit your player name, or if you have to activate it by yourself.

[h2]New Features :[/h2]
- Online : pressing the Menu button now shows a pop-up menu that will let you send Quick chat sentences or block the chat ; the current choice is activated when releasing the Menu button
- Online : if you cannot host, activate Training Club -> Network -> Assign Temporary IPv6 (only available if your network supports IPv6 and has a Temporary one) ; note : opponents whose network doesn't support IPv6 won't be able to join you (if it works for you, please report it !)

[h2]Changes :[/h2]
- Physics : in the big stadiums, the invisible walls around the courts are now better positioned so the players & the balls will be blocked near the actual walls
- AI : your player & the CPU, when standing near or after the baseline, know much better when the ball will end long, and thus won't play it, except when it's very close to being in

[h2]Bug Fixes :[/h2]
- World Tour : when the TEM2 mode was activated, your player skills were going down extremely fast once he was starting to be a bit old

notes.title: Version 0.90 - Build 118 ; SubBuild 2023.9.29
notes.notes:
Here's another regular updates with 3 main focus :
- gameplay fixes & improvements
- better handling of the controller in the menus
- better handling of crashes, so the user can exit the game correctly

The last 2 points are to prepare the port to consoles.

I hope you'll enjoy all this ! :-)

And as I'm currently working on improving the menu usage with a controller, if you have any suggestions, please don't hesitate to let me know.

[h2]New Features :[/h2]
- Controls : new screen right before playing to easily select the controller for each player
- Menus : in case of a crash during the World Tour process, a menu is shown to tell you to load your previously saved game (instead of being stuck on the waiting screen)
- Menus : in case of a non-stop crash of the menu system, a menu is shown to let you exit the game and possibly restart without Mod or with resetting all your settings
- Menus : added a tip next to the Back button to show what controller button is linked to it
- Settings :can reset all the settings on game launch with the command line "-resetsettings" (without the quotes) ; this includes your current Training Club players, but not your saved World Tour games

[h2]Changes :[/h2]
- Physics : the players (both CPU & Human) now take a bit more margin over the net when they have a low Topspin skill, to avoid doing too many net faults
- AI : the Incredible CPU was still too cautious, leading to too many slices ; now he should do noticeably fewer, especially when his Topspin and/or his Precision are low
- AI : in doubles, now the CPU positions itself correctly after a cross-hit from the baseline

[h2]Bug Fixes :[/h2]
- AI : the CPU could stop running too early when running toward or away from the net, making him miss easy balls ; this fix should greatly improve in some cases the serve & volley of the CPU, and its net rush
- AI : in doubles, the CPU on the baseline wasn't playing the crossed balls ending on his partner's side most of the time
- AI : in doubles, the CPU could try to catch a ball that was actually for his partner
- Modding : wrongly configured Mods could make the game unable to initialize correctly


ManuTOO
=== Mana Games ===

notes.title: Version 0.89 - Build 117 ; SubBuild 2023.9.6
notes.notes:
Here's another regular update. The most noticeable addition is the possibility to play TEM2 within TE4 if you have bought both games.

There are also several tuning & fixes done from user reports.

I hope you'll enjoy it. :-)

And here's the complete changelog.

[h2]New Features :[/h2]
- World Tour : if you have bought TEM2, you can now play it inside TE4 and become a tennis coach
- Localization : Czech translation by MichalR70 and Korean translation by Land of the sky, thanks to them ! ːsteamhappyː
- Commentary : about 200 new commentary lines about specific cases on the serve

[h2]Changes :[/h2]
- Strike : the volley drop shop is now a bit less efficient (ie: the opponent has a bit more time to reach it)
- Strike : the drop shot is now a bit more efficient
- Strike : the slice requires a tiny less preparation time to be hit efficiently
- Service : the strong and normal services on the 2nd serve have now significantly less precision (to simulate the stress)

[h2]Bug Fixes :[/h2]
- Acceleration style : the Heavy Hitter handicap wasn't applied
- Service : the services that should have been fast could actually end up being quite slow
- World Tour : fixed a few issues when setting up a doubles tournament, especially with more than 1 human players

[h2]Notes :[/h2]
- I didn't test too much how was working TEM2 inside TE4, so if you notice any issues, please let me know :fear:
- If you play with the Mod XKT, you'll have to disable it (by setting the Default profile) to be able to see the TEM2 icon in the Main menu and activate it


ManuTOO
=== Mana Games ===

notes.title: Version 0.88 - Build 116 ; SubBuild 2023.7.28
notes.notes:
Another regular update with a couple of new features and some fixes.

I hope you'll enjoy it ! :-)

[h2]New Features :[/h2]
- Strike : new acceleration style Momentum, that requires hitting strikes other than the acceleration to raise a bonus on the acceleration
- Audio : outdoor stadiums now have ambiance tracks (you can add your own by Modding the game ; check the "4) Ambiance Tracks" here https://www.managames.com/Forum/topic60-33725.php )

[h2]Changes :[/h2]
- Online : changed the Backhand Skills remapping for the Fair Mode to 20-70% instead of 15-65%
- Input : the ignored controllers are now hidden from the controller list (in Settings -> Controls)

[h2]Bug Fixes :[/h2]
- World Tour : way too many players were becoming potential #1 in the fictional years
- AI : the CPU in doubles was hitting a few balls (especially the ones landing near his feet)
- Animation : fixed a couple of dynamic animation glitches

notes.title: Version 0.87 - Build 115 ; SubBuild 2023.6.30
notes.notes:
Here's a mixed bag for an update, with little new things, changes & bug fixes touching many different aspects of the game. I hope you'll enjoy it ! :-)

[h2]New Features :[/h2]
- Match Recordings : now the game will automatically delete all recording older than 2 Builds (if you don't want to delete anything, read the notes below) ; you can also manually delete any recording
- Modding : you can now very easily any player photo ; HowTo => https://www.managames.com/Forum/topic60-34846.php
- Modding : press the left or right Control key to prevent the game to load any Mod ; you need to do that on the very 1st instant the game window is visible (this will still show the Modded screen, if any) ; this allows to easily uninstall a bugged Mod, if required

[h2]Changes :[/h2]
- Animation : now the dynamic animation moves a bit less the racket forward/backward to less disrupt the global swing speed
- Controls : added a number after the controller names when there are 2 identical controllers connected to your PC (or more), so it's easier to select them
- Acceleration Trait : Heavy Hitter move penalty slightly lowered (it's still a tiny bit above its value of 2 builds ago)
- Strike : raised a bit the topspin of the Short Acceleration when the ball is hit with the sweet spot, and raised a bit its overall precision

[h2]Bug Fixes :[/h2]
- Animation : having a longer strike animation could bring a very tiny advantage to the run acceleration
- Animation : fixed a couple of bugs where the dynamic strike animation was getting all weird
- Modding : some modded service animations last too long after the ball hit, which prevented the player to run ; now, the player will start his run even if the service animation isn't finished
- Modding : the line judge & the char umpire modded textures could get wrong when alternating between different modded stadiums
- Modding : fixed the creation of new materials
- AI : the CPU doubles partner could try to play ball that his human partner could reach

[h2]Notes :[/h2]
- Old Recorded Matches : if for some reason you want to keep all your old recorded matches, then before launching the game with this new update, add this line to your Tennis.ini, under [Record] : (HowTo => https://www.managames.com/Forum/topic19-32161.php )
AutoDelOldBuild = 0


ManuTOO
=== Mana Games ===

notes.title: Version 0.86 - Build 114 ; SubBuild 2023.6.9
notes.notes:
Another regular update aimed at the gameplay : the doubles should now be more or less done ; there are also a bunch of little tuning & adjustments to the strikes & the AI for Singles & Doubles.

I hope you'll enjoy it, and your comments are welcome as usual..! :-)

[h2]Changes :[/h2]
- Acceleration : Heavy Hitter move penalty slightly raised
- Strike : significantly lowered the precision when hitting an incoming heavily sliced ball
- Strike : the Short Acceleration Smash must now be slightly charged to get its full speed
- Strike : Slightly faster Short Accel
- Strike : Slightly faster Normal & Topspin strikes
- Strike : lowered the speed boost for the Smash from the Baseline when the Smash skill is very high (as the Smash, in this case, is already very powerful)
- AI : the CPU could attempt to do a drop shot when standing very far from the baseline

[h2]Bug Fixes :[/h2]
- Doubles : fixed a few more situations where the player was stopping to play and other oddities like that
- AI : big rebalancing of the aggressiveness of the CPU after finding a bad bug at the core of the system ; hopefully, it shouldn't change too much its behavior
- AI : the CPU wasn't doing slices often enough

notes.title: Version 0.85 - Build 111 ; SubBuild 2023.5.13
notes.notes:
Here's an important update for the doubles AI players, which should greatly lower the number of wrong behavior of the CPU in doubles (although it may create rarer but more intricate ones :fear: ).

And here's the complete changelog.

[h2]New Features :[/h2]
- Gameplay : new Acceleration Trait "Rapid Fire" => the acceleration is 5 km/h slower, but its preparation is 15% faster and it's 10% less tiring
- Modding : you can now change the Country 3-Letter codes by adding codes into Lang_English_Mod.txt ; here's an example : "CountryCHE SUI" => this will show "SUI" instead of "CHE" ; so no need to change the Country files anymore

[h2]Changes :[/h2]
- Strike : tuned a bit the slice so the maximum backspin is done when the ball is around the stomach height instead of the shoulder height
- AI : many improvements & fixes for the doubles CPU
- AI : the CPU should now catch a bit more balls when serving & volleying and when rushing the net

[h2]Bug Fixes :[/h2]
- AI : sometimes the CPU was thinking he'd need a long time to reach his current position and thus was doing a slice instead of a better strike for no apparent reason
- Modding : in some cases, the Profile screen was not displayed after installing a new Mod that was creating a new Profile
- Modding : if a Mod was depending on another Mod, it was still loaded even if that other Mod wasn't loaded with the current Profile

notes.title: Version 0.84 - Build 110 ; SubBuild 2023.5.5
notes.notes:
Here we go with another important update, bringing the Acceleration Traits, fixing the doubles AI, and the performances of Incredible difficulty level.

I hope you'll enjoy all these improvements ! :-)

And here is the complete changelog.

[h2]New Features :[/h2]
- Gameplay : added the "Acceleration Traits" ; each player can choose between 7 traits, giving speed bonuses & handicaps depending on different situations ; this might require some tuning, so don't hesitate to let me know if you feel something is off, and if you have ideas for new traits as well ! ːsteamthumbsupː
- Modding : added a button to open the Mods handled by ModIO on the bottom left of Settings -> Profiles

[h2]Changes :[/h2]
- AI : the Incredible CPU was almost totally paralyzed by the risk to put the ball into the net, making play way too many slices & safe strikes, and even more with the Elite controls ; now, the Incredible should be back and much more valiant :punch:
- Strikes : lowered by 3 km/h the maximum speed of the acceleration and 2 km/h the Shoulder Height bonus, so the maximum strike speed will be about the same when you get a bonus from an acceleration trait

[h2]Bug Fixes :[/h2]
- AI : fixed a bunches of cases where the CPU didn't want to play the ball in doubles, but should have played it :fear:
- Menu : it was not possible to open the Match Log (available in Settings -> World Tour & Training Club)

[h2]Notes :[/h2]
- If you want to change your Acceleration Trait in the World Tour, activate the DevMode (HowTo => https://www.managames.com/Forum/topic19-32161.php ), then once done turn it off

notes.title: Version 0.83 - Build 109 ; SubBuild 2023.4.25
notes.notes:
Here is an important update with the arrival of the ModIO plugin allowing you to subscribe & download Mods from within the game.

This should greatly ease the Modding, just don't forget to restart the game after each Mod change.

For now, you have to log in using your email ; I'll try to replace that with an automatic login when you use the Steam version, but I'm afraid this will not work well for people playing the game both off & on Steam, so I'll have to investigate more to know if I can implement this solution or not.

You'll also find all the uploaded Mods here : https://mod.io/g/tennis-elbow-4 .

Another noticeable addition is the handling of the controller's vibrations. Let me know if you have some ideas to improve them ! :-)

And here is the full changelog.

[h2]New Features :[/h2]
- Controls : now, your controller can vibrate when striking the ball ; activate this with Settings -> Controls -> Player 1 -> Vibration ; the deep vibrations indicate a difficult ball ; the light vibrations indicate a fast strike as well as an off-center ball ; and the light vibration duration indicates an off-center ball
- Modding : you can now download & install the Mods from within the game ! (the Mod authors will have to upload their Mod 1st ; HowTo => https://www.managames.com/Forum/topic60-34686.php )
- Modding : bind your Mod to a Profile, create a Profile .ini, and change the way to put saved Training Club Players in your Mod ; HowTo => https://www.managames.com/Forum/topic60-34687.php

[h2]Changes :[/h2]
- Stadium : moved a bit Rome's roof so its shadow stays farther from the baseline
- Tiredness : the acceleration's tiredness is lowered by 10%
- Strike : with Slice Mastery, the slice speed has been slightly raised around the baseline
- Strike : removed the speed bonus for the Backhand Smash from the baseline (so now it applies to only the forehand smash)
- Strike : lowered the energy bonus when the strike power is more than 20% under the stamina
- Strike : lowered the precision bonus when the strike power is more than 20% under the precision

[h2]Bug Fixes :[/h2]
- Strike : since the previous Build, the drop shot was usually too high, except when executed far from the baseline

notes.title: Version 0.81 - Build 105 ; SubBuild 2023.3.20
notes.notes:
Here the 1st important gameplay update since a while as I'm focusing on the gameplay for now.

I tuned the slice as it didn't have enough backspin rotation to represent the modern tennis (we were closer to the 90's tennis, before the major string change that occurred around the early 2000's).

This makes the slice a bit slower in most situations, and sometimes not just a bit (especially with the Slice Mastery talent).

If the change affects you, either in a good or bad way, please let me know in the comments, so I'll know if I have to tune it more and in what direction. :-)


[h2]New Features :[/h2]
- Player Style : now the Counter Puncher gets a lowered speed handicap when doing an acceleration on a raising ball (and in a smaller way on a falling ball), as well as with the normal strike against a raising ball

[h2]Changes :[/h2]

- Strikes : tuned the drop shot & the slice to get a more realistic backspin rate on them
- Strikes : slightly raised the forehand slice speed, especially when prepared early

[hr][/hr]

- Animation : the ball could be hit before the strike animation hit time
- Animation : the strike animation could jerk a bit when missing the ball (once more :sweat: )

notes.title: Version 0.64 - Build 88 ; SubBuild 2022.5.29

Here the v0.64 of Tennis Elbow 4 !

The main addition of this new version is 3 new stadiums, bringing the total to 20.

If the game sales allow it, I may produce 2 more stadiums for the Future tournaments in the future, but for now, the stadiums are done. However, I might add night sessions at some point, if there's no technical issue with that.

So this update is done almost for the 1-year anniversary of the Early Access release on Steam. 1 year ago, I was kinda hoping to have the v1.0 or near it by now, but I was a bit too optimistic on one side, and on another one life decided otherwise (see the mini-blog if you'd like the details of all my little & bigger problems : https://www.managames.com/Forum/topic15-31541.php ːsteammockingː ).

Anyway, I hope the v1.0 is done or nearly done in 1 year. Since the beginning of the year, my work rhythm has been better, despite many annoyances on my path (but smaller than last year), and then I'll start to try to port the game to consoles.

Meanwhile, I wish you to enjoy tennis & TE4, and cu soon for more incoming updates. ːsteamhappyː

- Gameplay : lowered the extra-reach for all the strikes when the ball is very low or very high (as the racket describes somewhat of a circle instead of a linear limit), which should avoid some weird animations and give a more realistic reach overall
- Animation : the players won't try anymore to hit the ball after it has bounced against a wall, to avoid doing weird animations

[h2]Bug Fixes :[/h2]
- AI : fixed a couple of animation desync issues for the CPU
- Animation : fixed a little jerking that could happen when the human player had missed the ball

notes.title: Version 0.49 - Build 71 ; SubBuild 2022.1.26
notes.notes:
[h2]New Features :[/h2]
- Sound : new umpire voices, 1 from the UK, 1 from the US and 1 in German (thanks to Paulie, Bob Madden & Patrick Geyer !), and the base umpire voices have been redone as well
- Modding : new way to Mod the Grunt, all the court sounds, and the Umpire announcements => https://www.managames.com/Forum/topic60-33725.php

[h2]Changes :[/h2]
- World Tour : the women now serve about 4km/h faster when they have 50% in their Service Power skill
- World Tour : the players get tired faster if you have chosen to play with fewer sets than in real life (eg: a 1-set match instead of a best-of-3-set match)

[h2]Bug Fixes :[/h2]
- Animation : the player could jerk left/right before hitting the ball with the Fast Autopositionning (and possibly some other situation)
- World Tour : crash fixed when starting a new game with more than 1 player
- World Tour : Junior ranking was changing on reload during the 1st year of your career
- World Tour : loading an old saved game with a player chosen fro the base (instead of a created one) could make the game crash

notes.title: Version 0.48 - Build 69 ; SubBuild 2022.1.15
notes.notes:
After a big stall of nearly 2 months because I got badly sick and then was left very tired, here the 1st important update in a while, with a long-awaited new feature : the sliding..! ːsteamhappyː

It'll likely be tuned and evolve a bit with future updates, but the basics are all there, and it looks quite nice to see the players finally sliding.

And here is the changelog for this new version :

[h2]New Features :[/h2]
- Gameplay : now the players can slide, on all surfaces but more often on clay & grass ; this provides a bit of extra reach ; the sliding is automatic if you have enough speed and stand at the correct distance and if the ball isn't too high, but if you don't press a strike button at the correct time, the sliding will start a tiny bit late and your player will be a tiny too much on the ball ; when you slide, you put less spin in the ball on the normal & slice strike
- Strike : added a 2nd double-handed forehand, very loosely inspired from Gambill ːsteammockingː
- Hall of Fame : updated all the real records to the end of 2021

[h2]Changes :[/h2]
- Surface : tuned a bit the color of the grass, clay & blue-green cement courts (only in the 3D courts for now, not the 2D Backgrounds)
- Animation : fixed the off-hand on the 1st double-handed forehand
- World Tour : now, in Pro difficulty and above, you'll get a bit more experience points overall, and your skills will drop a bit less fast
- World Tour : raised a bit the resting rate of your player when his ranking get very good

[h2]Bug Fixes :[/h2]
- Menu : the selection with a controller could get blocked in the "Exit current match" screen
- Gameplay : the service line was seen as bigger than it was by the line judges
- Gameplay : fixed a crash that could happen when pressing the acceleration buttons right before starting to serve
- Helpers : "[Network] HideOppHelper" wasn't working correctly (it's in your Tennis.ini)
- Recording : launching a recorded match without having loaded a World Tour saved game 1st was making the game crash
- World Tour : your player was sleeping (and thus wasn't resting) if you had played too much during the same day (ie: playing singles + doubles)
- World Tour : player's potentials when starting a new career with an existing player were all wrong (since the previous update)
- World Tour : most women had a one-handed backhand instead of a 2 handed one
- World Tour : the yearly stats of a Junior ending #1 that year were hidden
- World Tour : the game could crash on a new week, after adding a player in the player base & then loading a saved game ; this bug could also do some funky stuff on the past rankings of the players (visible when seeing H2H or stuff like that)
- World Tour : the OutfitTE4 codes in the player base weren't loaded correctly

notes.title: Tennis Elbow 4 - Early Version Modding SDK
notes.notes:
The TE4 Early Version Modding SDK is finally here : https://www.managames.com/Forum/topic60-33540.php .

Alongside, you'll also find the Outfit Modding SDK there : https://www.managames.com/Forum/topic60-33539.php .

This will allow to easily create new outfits for the players, and install them by only copying the files in the correct folder (ie: there's no editing the game .ini files anymore for the end-user).

The Modding SDK gives you access to all the menu & HUD scripts & images, as well as the sounds, the 2D courts, the Tour bases and other smaller things.

And if you have issues or questions about the Mod creation process, let me know, I'll try to help you.

I can't wait to see what great things the Modders will create with all this !

ManuTOO
=== Mana Games ===

notes.title: Tennis Elbow 4 - Version 0.46 - Build 60
notes.notes:
Finally, the outfit modding is coming !

With it, most of the game is now moddable, although some things will change in the future to be easier to Mod (mostly the sounds, and the 2D court organization).

You'll still have to wait tomorrow (or Thursday) to get your hands on the TE4 Modding SDK that will allow you to Mod the outfit.

And here the changelog for this new version :

[h2]New Features :[/h2]
- Outfit : separated the left & right wristbands, so they can be tuned independently
- Outift : separated the mesh selection from the texture selection for the hats, so it'll be easier to add modded textures for each hat
- Modding : the engine can load outfit images (wait for the Modding SDK to use that functionality)
- Modding : the CPU players in the World Tour without an outfit code can now use the modded animations as well as the modded outfits

[h2]Changes :[/h2]
- AI : raised by ~50% the efficiency of the Self Confidence, so if a CPU player plays vs himself, except he has 100% in Self Confidence and the other one has 0%, then he'll win nearly 60% of the sets
- Animation : slightly lowered the reach of the 2-handed forehand while on the run and significantly lower the reach on both sides, for all animations, when running back to the baseline ; all this is to prevent too weird stretching from the dynamic animation system

[h2]Bug Fixes :[/h2]
- Gameplay : the Surface skills, although hidden from the GUI, were still active during the game
- Animation : since the last Build, the CPU could sidestep all the way back from the net to the baseline when he had to do a smash there ; now, he'll just run back normally
- Animation : fixed a few cases where the human-controller player could wrongly predict when he was going to hit the ball, leading to strange things in the dynamic animation system, as well as gliding & animation jerking
- Animation : the human-controller player could hit clip the ball (and do a fault) instead of waiting for a tiny bit more to hit it back into play (when the ball was going to the player on left/right instead of going away from him)
- Animation : when running back to the baseline, the ball height could be wrongly predicted, leading the dynamic animation system to compress the player into the ground ':D
- Helpers : the Danger Zone wasn't displayed if the ball was going extremely high (ie: ~15 meters or more)

[h2]Notes :[/h2]
- The TE4 Modding SDK should come tomorrow (or else it'll be on Thursday :fear: )
- Your current outfit in your saved Career may be partially changed ; you can re-tune it by clicking on your 3D player in the Character Sheet

notes.title: Tennis Elbow 4 - Version 0.45
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 0.45[/h1]

Here's the full support for the controllers with dedicated icons and a better default configuration for the XBox & Playstation controllers, as well as an easier menu navigation ; I hope it works well, but if you notice anything wrong, don't hesitate to let me know..! :-)

[h2]New Features :[/h2]
- Controls : added icons to clearly represent the different axis and buttons of the XBox & Playstation controller, as well as a new default configuration for this type of controllers
- Controls : switched to Rewired plugin[i] (1)[/i], which should better handle controllers in a general way, especially exotic ones[i] (2)[/i]
- Controls : up/down and left/right are now correctly handled, so the menu navigation with a controller should be much easier than before[i] (3)[/i]
- Controls : you should be able now to plug-in & remove your controller while the game is running

[h2]Changes :[/h2]
- World Tour : Taiwan has been renamed to Chinese Tapei, as by sport competition standards

[h2]Bug Fixes :[/h2]
- World Tour : age of your player could be incorrect on the Week 52
- World Tour : Indoor streaks were counting as Synthethic or Hard
- World Tour : fixed a crash when starting a career with 4 players in season mode
- Animation : on MacOs Big Sur, the players could get their knees up in the air

[h2]Notes :[/h2]
(1) - if you're on Mac or if you were using the triggers, this will change your current controls, so don't forget to check them in the Controls menu
(2) - please let me know if your controller still doesn't work correctly with this version
(3) - if you see some weird stuff happening when navigating the menus with a controller, please let me know

notes.title: Version 0.44
notes.notes:
[h2]New Features :[/h2]
- Modding : can change the number of talent stars when starting a new game with the NbStar entry under [WT_NewGame] in your Tennis.ini

[h2]Changes :[/h2]
- Gameplay : now when the Short Term form lowers, it'll also make the max energy lower till ~90%, even before reaching the threshold
- Gameplay : it's a bit less penalizing to hit the volley off-centered, so the extra-reach is more useful and let you do more decent shots
- Gameplay : it's not possible to have net balls on the 2nd serve for the human players, as there was a light risk to double fault because of it
- AI : the CPU predicts now better the chance a ball can go too wild, and thus do a bit less stupid faults (especially when his Tactic skill is high)
- AI : the CPU now doesn't use the Short Acceleration anymore if it has too much chance to not be short enough (especially when his Tactic skill is high)
- Talent : the Slice Mastery talent slightly raises the slice precision, so it's more efficient when prepared a bit late
- Control : autopos now makes your player go backward if you try to smash a high ball after it has bounced
- Online : the game now automatically auto-repings the hosts that didn't answer (ie: with red infinite pings)

[h2]Bug Fixes :[/h2]
- Animation : fixed a frozen animation when trying to smash a ball too high to be hit
- Animation : fixed a couple of animation issues when the CPU player was late to play a smash
- AI : when running backward, the CPU could hit the ball before the bounce while he had decided to actually hit it after the bounce
- HUD : the indicated stress from playing against a lower-ranked player was much bigger than what it really was
- HUD : the aiming preview was turned a bit too much when aiming to the left or right
- Gameplay : the stress from playing against a lower-ranked player cannot lower anymore when starting the 2nd serve
- Physics : the ball would go more easily wild always on the same side (ie: left or right)
- Replay : starting/stopping a replay during a gesture that moved the racket was leading to the racket being mispositioned
- Replay : viewing a point replay could create desyncs during the match replay (it may still not be fixed at 100%, as it's pretty hard to reproduce that bug :fear: )
- World Tour : on saved game reload, some of the Prizes from Pro tournaments were $0 during the year you had decided to turn pro
- World Tour : during the fictional years, on saved game reload, the low-ranked players in the base who got a fate of future top players were seeing their mental skills reset to their original values, making all the other skills way too high
- World Tour : when starting a Season Mode career, picking more than 1 player was leading to wrong starting age & skills

notes.title: Version 0.43 ; Build 54 ; SubBuild 2021.6.22
notes.notes:
[h2]New Features :[/h2]
- Online : if you press a Modifier Key (Right Control & Shit by default), display a list of all Quick Chat keys triggered by this Modifier key (and another key)
- Career : can now change the starting age when starting a new career as a Pro

[h2]Changes :[/h2]
- Career : it's now possible to change at any time the strike animations & grunts (it's less realistic, but just more convenient, especially for the future console players)
- Strike : nerf a bit the slice, so it's a bit slower when well hit, and noticeably slower when badly hit
- Strike : strongly lowered the spin handicap when hitting a topspin strike on the run
- Strike : strongly lowered the tolerance on raising balls to trigger the Shoulder Height acceleration bonus (ie: if you take the ball a bit too much before its highest point, you won't get a speed bonus on your strike)
- Strike : raised a bit the racket reach when running to the side
- Strike : better prediction if the player will be able to strike the ball or not (so the player won't air-swing if the ball is too far from him)
- Talent : the Slice Mastery talent now strongly reduces the handicap of hitting poorly a slice instead of raising the strike speed

[h2]Bug Fixes :[/h2]
- Animation : fixed several weird dynamic animations when the player was hitting (or almost hitting) a ball far from him, and/or on the run
- Animation : the animation could get slightly out of sync when running after the ball (which was also additionally creating weird dynamic animations)

[h2]Notes :[/h2]
- More tuning on the topspin strike efficiency will come ; this Build is hopefully a 1st step in the good direction...
